आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:
PM-KISAN: Aadhaar, 7/12 land record (किंवा तत्सम कागदपत्र), Bank passbook
Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi: Aadhaar, 7/12 land record (महाराष्ट्र), Bank passbook, PM-KISAN registration proof
Ladki Bahin (Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana): Aadhaar, Residence proof (domicile/birth certificate), Income certificate, Bank passbook, Age proof
